EmailTemplate.subject: IMPORTANT: {!Insurance__c.Opportunity__c} Homeowner’s Insurance Renewal
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Valued Investor,
It is time for your annual property and liability insurance policy through Valentine Insurance Services to be renewed.
This renewal email was updated recently, so please be sure to read it in its entirety. As always, thank you for your time and attention to this important information.
Overview of Important Details:
*Your new policy will provide Replacement Cost Coverage up to the Reported (Insured) Value on your Evidence of Insurance (EOI) plus 25%, if applicable. The EOI uploaded in your owner’s portal includes a Reported (Insured) Value consistent with a minimum of $110 per square foot.
If your evidence of insurance shows the premium is escrowed from a lender, we will invoice the lender and await their payment. Please verify that your lender’s name and loan # are correct on your Evidence of Insurance. If either the lender or loan number have changed, please let us know promptly.
If your evidence of insurance shows the premium is non-escrowed or it has no mortgage company listed, we will be deducting the premium from your rental account at Premier Property Management mid-month of the month following your renewal date.
If management of the property ends for any reason, the insurance policy will terminate effective the same date that management is terminated.
Have you recently put a property into an LLC or Trust? If so, have you notified our insurance department so that your coverage details can be updated? If not, please email insurance@reination.com and let us know so we can have your insurance documents updated.
*If you would like to discuss the Reported (Insured) Value of your property further, have Valentine Insurance run a replacement cost estimate for you, or discuss other options, please reach out to our dedicated Valentine team at 1-800-772-0535 or email at investorinsurance@valentine.insure.*
Property Under Renewal:
{!Insurance__c.Opportunity__c}
How To Access Your Evidence of Insurance (EOI) & Your 2026 Valentine Homeowner's Insurance FAQ/Coverage Summary:
• Go to your owner's portal for the property in question.
• From your dashboard, click "Documents" on the left side menu. ("Statements" will appear at the top.)
• Scroll down to the "Other Documents" section. At the bottom of this section, choose "Show 100 entries" from the dropdown menu.
• Scroll back up to the heading "Other Documents." On the right-hand side please click the "uploaded" word twice so the most recent dates appear near the top of the list.
• Search list for house number (example "399 Savage Lane EOI xx/xx/2026") to access your EOI.
• Click the name of the file and it will download to a pdf.
• Also click the FAQ/Coverage Summary Sheet to download it.
• Open the pdfs and review all pages.
Thank you for your attention to these matters. It is greatly appreciated.
- Jill Griffith
